'''Forsaken Tunnels''' is a hidden [[dungeon]] found in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Pre-Searing Ascalon]]. The entrance lies within [[The Northlands]], north of [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)|Piken Square]], and can only be entered by teams that have at least one person who has completed [[A Bastion In the North]]. The area is inhabited by hostile Charr forces and contains several branching tunnels filled with enemies and environmental hazards.

==Dialogue==
Approaching the Dungeon Lock while a quest is active or the party is not in {{reforgedmode}}:
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"Looks like we don't have access. Did someone forget to put on their '''Reforged Badge'''?"''

==Notes==
*While the initial quest [[Long Thought Forgotten]] takes you to the entrance to the east of the Northlands, completing that quest opens up the west entrance, just north-east of [[Piken Square]] behind the charr encampment.
*Because this area is mechanically part of the [[Depths of Tyria]], the [[Vanguard Initiate]] and [[Reforged Mode (effect)|Reforged Mode]] [[effect]]s are not applied.
**Like in pre-Searing Ascalon, however, party members do not suffer [[Death Penalty]], and enemies have reduced health in Reforged Mode.
*Progress through this dungeon depends on multiple quests:
**The dungeon cannot be entered if any party members have [[Across the Wall]] or [[A Bastion In the North]] active in their [[quest log]].
**If no party members have [[Charr in the Tunnels]] or [[The Scourge Beneath]], or if any party member has [[Long Thought Forgotten]], the party cannot advance to the second level.
**If no party members have The Scourge Beneath, or if any party member has Charr in the Tunnels, the party cannot advance to the third level.
**Quest spawns will not appear if any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode. This prevents access to levels two and three, since Wyle Brimscourge will not spawn.
**If every member of the party who has The Scourge Beneath leaves after reaching level 2 of the dungeon, remaining players can still fight [[Maz Scourgeheart]] and spawn the reward chest.
*The presence, level, and skills of some Charr foes in the dungeon scale with that of the lowest-leveled player in the party:

*Walking over the patches of blue, crystalline ground will inflict the [[Crippled]] condition for 15 seconds and the [[Dazed]] condition for 20 seconds. This [[environment effect]] affects all allies, including [[pet]]s and owned [[minion]]s, but does not affect any foes.
*The plants and bandits are hostile towards all other creature types, including each other.
*No [[Locked Chest]]s or [[Hidden Stash]]es spawn inside the dungeon.
{{anomaly|The dungeon's icon on the map does not change when a character completes the dungeon.}}

==Trivia==
* This dungeon was added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260401|April 1st, 2026]] update.
* This is the only location accessible before [[the Searing]] where [[rare]] or [[perfect]] weapons will drop, and the only place in [[Prophecies]] where [[inscribable]] weapons will drop.
* When the dungeon was first released, [[Maz's Chest]] could drop [[inscribable|uninscribable]] [[Item rarity|rare]] weapons with [[inherent modifier]]s. These were subsequently removed and replaced with inscribable drops, but an unknown number of uninscribable rare weapons still exist in the hands of players in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* Although it is part of the [[Depths of Tyria]], the dungeon plays the same soundtrack as surface explorable areas in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]].
